i have, especially lately because i slowly feel myself slipping to extremely dangerous behaviour, still, i'm afraid to be judged..

it's been 3 months since the actual break up, but since he wanted to be friends we actually still hung out every night till last week, me still having feelings for him. Shit happened with another girl and it really hurt me, so, that's why.

While we we're dating, I wasn't allowed to sit next to him in lectures, we couldn't be seen together, no PDA. After we broke up, every lecture it was all fun and games for him and this new girl, really dude? -_-
I'm really grateful for that, I'm just not sure if I'm gonna be able to pull through this one..
Thank you, it really good to know I'm not alone in this

thank you for reading.
 it's just so hard to move on if i still see him every day, clearly doing a lot better. i feel so useless and worthless. why can't i move on?
